basics.name: Devansh Kumar
basics.headline: Software Engineer II at Microsoft
basics.resumeHeadline: Software Engineer II | Full-Stack, Azure Cloud, and AI Agents
basics.tagline: I build secure, scalable cloud platforms on Azure and AI agents that make engineering teams faster.
basics.summary: Software Engineer II at Microsoft with 3+ years building full-stack, cloud-native Azure systems (C#/.NET, React, TypeScript, KQL). Owned architecture, auth, and data ingestion for an AI content authoring and content-health dashboard; doubled monthly users of Microsoft 365 Lighthouse security baselines; won two Microsoft hackathons with agentic AI.

highlights.label: monthly users of security baselines in Microsoft 365 Lighthouse after I shipped task-update notifications
increase in security-baseline cloning after my UX redesign
fewer Lighthouse incidents in a reliability drive where I introduced a self-healing alert tier
Microsoft hackathon awards for agentic AI: Code to Content (2026) and an AI incident agent (2025)

groups.name: AI-powered content authoring and content-health dashboard (greenfield)

bullets.text: Owned platform architecture on Azure (Container Apps, App Service, Entra ID, Azure Data Explorer), defining the repo strategy, layered Backend-for-Frontend design, and a data access layer of reusable KQL functions.

Cut API latency and application compute load by moving core business logic into Azure Data Explorer (Kusto) functions with query optimization and native caching, leaving the data access layer as thin, parameterized queries.

Built OAuth 2.0 authentication with least-privilege Entra ID (Azure AD) app registrations, JWT validation (signature, issuer, audience, lifetime, scope), and a token-validation API, meeting Microsoft's Secure Future Initiative standards.

Built the dashboard's GitHub-issue ingestion pipeline into Azure Data Explorer (.NET worker on Container Apps Jobs) with polling, checkpointing, and retries; provisioned via Bicep with OpenTelemetry alerts and auto-created incidents.

Built the dashboard's GitHub-issue ingestion pipeline into Azure Data Explorer as a .NET worker on Container Apps Jobs with polling, checkpointing, and resilience logic; provisioned it with Bicep (managed identity, Storage, Key Vault) with OpenTelemetry, alerts, and auto-created incidents, so new repos and issue types onboard easily.

Shipped the dashboard's one-click accuracy reviews: APIs that rank support articles due for review by page views and open a reviewable GitHub pull request in ~2–4 s via a GitHub App, so experts fix high-traffic articles first.

Made the platform fully infrastructure-as-code with Bicep and Azure DevOps CI/CD (Azure Data Explorer, Container Apps Jobs, E2E pipelines), eliminating configuration drift and turning new security requirements into code changes.

Raised release confidence with non-flaky Playwright E2E pipelines (federated-identity auth, near-zero false positives) and production-like Azure Load Testing, which drove production-parity environment upgrades.

Fixed mismatched accuracy dashboards (only 142 of 278 dashboard views matched GitHub) with strict label-based issue-to-product matching and a reversible, versioned data re-map (plan, apply, verify, undo).

Delivered the proof of concept that validated the platform's architecture, data model, and auth design before build-out, and prototyped an authenticated Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI agents.

groups.name: Content publishing platform for Microsoft Support
groups.context: Production operations, release engineering, AI automation

bullets.text: Built a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) help agent over internal docs and troubleshooting guides that on-call engineers use to resolve known issues and unblock customers.

Introduced versioned release branches with rollback for two platforms, mitigating a top-severity (Sev1) outage within an hour; resolved Sev1s on support pages and knowledge-base redirects (Azure DevOps throttling).

Diagnosed an Azure Cognitive Search indexing failure in a high-priority escalation with no prior ramp-up; unblocked a partner team's monthly reporting by updating indexer fields when a code fix couldn't ship.
Ramped up on Azure Synapse and Scala within a month to own log and user-feed data pipelines, restored the beta environment, and wrote documentation and debugging guides for the system.

Automated release and review workflows: GitHub Copilot agents for releases and pipeline runs, a release-branching script separating production and pre-production deployments, and AI code-review bot skills.

Fixed the PR build pipeline (unsupported package version) to unblock frontend deployments, restored critical service accounts to unblock localization, and created short links and runbooks that sped up common developer tasks.

groups.name: Microsoft 365 Lighthouse
groups.context: Multi-tenant portal for IT service providers (MSPs) to manage and secure customers

bullets.text: Redesigned security baselines (reusable security-policy templates, e.g., require MFA, that MSPs deploy to customer tenants) with one-click cloning of Microsoft's defaults, lifting cloning 80%+ and core-action completion 20%+.

Redesigned security baselines (reusable security-policy templates, e.g., require MFA, that MSPs deploy to customer tenants): one-click cloning of Microsoft's defaults, clearer custom authoring, and onboarding coach marks, lifting cloning 80%+ and completion of core actions 20%+ (adjusted for user growth).

Shipped update badges and banners that flag when Microsoft revises a baseline's security task so MSPs redeploy it, driving a 2.3x month-over-month jump in visits and a sustained 2x in monthly users; adopted product-wide.

Productized my hackathon prototype that shows, on the baselines page, which customer tenants use each baseline and their rollout status (deployment plan), reaching a 5.9% click-through rate in month one.

Built Microsoft 365 Copilot adoption insights for MSPs: Copilot-task filters on baselines and deployment plans, a recommended-tasks side panel delivered after code freeze to keep a high-visibility launch on time, telemetry, and a self-service purchases metric (API and UI).

Helped cut Lighthouse incidents by 70%+ by introducing a self-heal tier: noisy alerts (e.g., VM health) stay notifications and page on-call only past thresholds; automated incident filtering and tuned monitors.

Built Microsoft Graph APIs backed by Azure Data Explorer for partner sales insights (subscription renewals, license opportunities, user preferences); fixed pagination and lifted a 7-partner-ID filter limit with an in-operator query.

Raised test coverage with an AI instructions file for generating unit tests and Storybook stories with VS Code agents (adopted team-wide), new baselines UI unit tests, stabilized Playwright E2E tests, and a repaired E2E pipeline.

Uncovered and fixed Lighthouse-wide issues (broken empty states replaced with shared components, accessibility bugs, an infinite loading shimmer, permission tags) and trimmed page URLs to essential fields for security.

Automated quarterly test-tenant onboarding (a security-compliance requirement) with AI; wrote PowerShell tools for test-account setup and Microsoft Graph API schema (CSDL) validation; fixed the schema-publishing pipeline.
Prototyped Copilot agents that bring Lighthouse into Microsoft Teams and used Azure OpenAI function calling with GPT models to automate deploying security-baseline tasks (hackathons).
Built immediate and flexible Android in-app updates for the Microsoft 365 Admin app, raising the update rate by 60%.

Evaluated Xamarin-based and native Google Play In-App Updates approaches and implemented both immediate and flexible update flows in the Microsoft 365 Admin Android app, improving the app update rate by 60%.
Fixed edge-case bugs, validated the feature through alpha and internal beta testing on 10-20 devices, and presented the POC demo, tech doc, and recommendation to the team.

leadership.text: Mentored new hires as the team doubled; Cosmos DB expert and point of contact for Microsoft Graph API reviews.
Mentored and onboarded new hires as the India team doubled; authored the team's Getting Started guide and kept a living runbook of commands and links that unblocked teammates.

Cosmos DB subject-matter expert and single point of contact for the team's Microsoft Graph API design reviews; ran knowledge-transfer sessions on Graph deployment and schema publishing, Kusto-backed APIs, and AI tools.
Go-to engineer for product managers' data queries and analysis; proactively cleaned up pending incidents and updated troubleshooting guides in areas beyond my ownership.

projects.name: Face Analyzer (Final Year Project)
projects.text: Web app that analyzes a face from a camera capture or uploaded image using transfer-learning models, with a downloadable report and email delivery (EmailJS, Yagmail); deployed on Streamlit and GitHub Pages.

projects.name: Face Mask Detector
projects.text: CNN-based face mask detector trained on a public Kaggle dataset and deployed as a Streamlit web app.

education.degree: Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science and Engineering

awards.text: Winner, Harden the Core Franchise category (Data Platform Growth org), Microsoft Global Hackathon 2026: Code to Content, agentic AI that updates docs as products change, so users and AI agents get accurate answers.

Best Hack, Live Site & Automation category (Data Platform Growth org), Microsoft Hackathon 2025: an AI agent that triages and resolves production incidents through multiple MCP servers; later piloted internally.
